cohort: 287 women with postdated pregnancies (beyond 41 weeks) at the Department of Gynecology, Hayatabad Medical Complex, Peshawar
finding: Postdated pregnancies were associated with a higher risk of fetal distress (16%), macrosomia (18.5%), birth asphyxia (18.1%), meconium aspiration (8.4%), and NICU admission (9.1%).
